method.webmcp_task_boundary: Puppeteer WebMCP add_elements plus fit_to_content completion on a mounted local page; component time is the sum of page PerformanceMeasure entries.
method.official_mcp_task_boundary: Streamable HTTP create_view completion on the pinned local server; checkpoint read is an untimed semantic oracle and widget render is excluded.
method.comparability: Task semantics and local machine are controlled. Component durations contain different work and are not an end-to-end protocol ranking.
